scope: CPU source review and actual protocol-owner controls; no physical GPU timing qualification
findings: Runner records completed-token per-stage elapsed time on its own coordinator clock, not GPU timer or cross-host synchronized clocks. Aggregate work is linear in stage count per completed token.

Activity uses existing delta/final frames; explicit request opt-in leaves older requesters unchanged. The delayed delta acknowledgment test asserts only three delta RPCs, with all numerical stage calls completed before release.

Receiver binds full route/attempt to admitted input, validates safe counts and nonnegative finite monotonic totals, allows coalesced empty-token observations, and rejects changed final aggregates before final-only callback.
Workspace changes only transient execution timing state; duplicate and late activity cannot alter completed text or grant authority.
Output text and canonical publication remain distinct; no telemetry acceptance is a numerical, hardware or release acceptance.
